description: This Java class 'InMemoryMonolithQueueFactory' implements multiple queue factory interfaces for in-memory queue management in a monolithic environment. It provides methods to create various producers and consumers for different message types, manages queue templates, and includes scheduled stats printing.

classes.name: InMemoryMonolithQueueFactory
